android.releaseNotes:
• 120fps Rebuild Optimizations: Replaced root shell and feed timer watchers with scoped selectors.
• Form & Input Stability: Fixed ChatInputArea ValueNotifier lifecycle and debounced user searches.
• Adaptive & Responsive Layouts: Responsive grid scaling in Collections, pull-to-refresh on empty feeds, and desktop width bounds.
• Design System Harmonization: Unified OasisColors and semantic Material 3 theme tokens.
